subject: Decision Making
title: Centaur Decision Making
description: A quick, practical guide to Centaur Decision Making.

hook.text: In 2005, two amateurs with three laptops beat chess grandmasters and supercomputers.

buildup.text: Garry Kasparov called this centaur chess. A human-computer team outperforms the strongest AI or the strongest human.

discovery.text: The human provides strategic judgment and creativity. The machine provides calculation speed and consistency.

twist.text: This principle extends beyond chess. In medical imaging, pathology, and cybersecurity, centaur teams lead the field.

climax.text: The future is not AI replacing humans. It is humans who leverage AI replacing those who do not.

punchline.text: Amateurs with laptops beat grandmasters. Human plus machine beats everything.

quiz.question: What is centaur decision-making?
options: Human-machine teams that outperform either humans or AI working alone
